messages:
maria: FYI we're planning a controlled sampling window during tomorrow's base-image rebuild. Lots of verify/pull noise expected. Suggest 30m staging canary then 1h prod; sample only info-level, non-KMS events at 10%. @ash @ben please review.

ash: Sampling must run after enrichment so KMS tags survive. Legal may request raw unwrap traces.

maria: Agreed. Flow: raw -> enrich/tag -> ephemeral(24h) -> sampler -> long-term. Exclude any event with metadata.kms=true or level!=info.

ben: Make sure tagging happens in keystore.Unwrap() and signer.Verify() paths and add unit tests.

ops_jia: RBAC: who can flip sampling? Need a narrow role, not org-admins.

maria: Propose role `audit-ops` with secretsmanager:PutSecretValue on audit-config-* and iam:PassRole to canary-runner, explicitly no kms:Decrypt.

samir: Will sampled events show in console? SRE needs visibility.

maria: Yes, low-cost index with "sampled (10%)" badge. We can rehydrate ephemeral buffer to full index for a timeframe on request (manual, costed).

sec-bot: Note: policy deviations require a JIRA ticket + two security approvers.

maria: Actions: maria open JIRA + canary playbook (EOD), ben PR sampler rule + tests (tomorrow AM), ops_jia request role + temp-creds doc (tomorrow), ash update runbook (Fri), samir cost estimate + alert (tomorrow). Staging canary 09:00 UTC, prod 09:30 UTC tomorrow unless objections.
